#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
SUB = "/workspace/submission/main.py"

def compile_prog(cfg):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[:400]
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    path = os.path.join(d, "program.json")
    open(path, "w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout), separators=(",", ":")))
    return path, d

def run(path, data, limit_mb=512, timeout=60):
    def pre():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (limit_mb*1024*1024, limit_mb*1024*1024))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=timeout, preexec_fn=pre)
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    return time.time()-t0, p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, ru.ru_maxrss

def canonical(v):
    return len(json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("ascii"))

# A1b: max-width state, never completing
rules = [{"id": 0, "class": 1, "priority": 5, "ranges": [[1000,1010]]*31 + [[-7,-7]]}]
for i in range(1, 2048):
    rules.append({"id": i, "class": 2, "priority": 1, "ranges": [[-3,-3]]})
cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":4,"rules":rules,"fallback":{"class":3}}
path, d = compile_prog(cfg)
reqs = [json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0})+"\n"]
t = 0; pk = 0
while pk < 1000000:
    ch = []
    for _ in range(1024):
        t += 1; ch.append({"flow":1,"time":t,"source":0,"length":1000}); pk += 1
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})+"\n")
dt, rc, out, err, rss = run(path, "".join(reqs).encode())
print("A1b max-state no-match: %.2fs rc=%d out=%.1fMB rss=%dMB err=%r" % (dt, rc, len(out)/1e6, rss//1024, err[:150]))

# C: 100k requests
reqs = [json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0})+"\n"]
for i in range(99999):
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"tick","time":i})+"\n")
dt, rc, out, err, rss = run(path, "".join(reqs).encode())
print("C 100k tick requests: %.2fs rc=%d out=%.1fMB err=%r" % (dt, rc, len(out)/1e6, err[:150]))

# D: 4096 flows + 3 checkpoints -> size check
rules2 = []
for i in range(512):
    rules2.append({"id": i, "class": 2, "priority": 1, "ranges": [[1000,1010]]*31+[[-7,-7]]})
cfg2 = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules2,
        "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
path2, d2 = compile_prog(cfg2)
reqs = []
t = 0
for f in range(4096):
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})+"\n")
for rounds in range(3):
    for f in range(4096):
        ch = []
        for _ in range(20):
            t += 1; ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":0,"length":1000})
        reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})+"\n")
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op":"checkpoint"})+"\n")
dt, rc, out, err, rss = run(path2, "".join(reqs).encode(), timeout=120)
lines = out.splitlines()
print("D 4096 flows + checkpoints: %.2fs rc=%d rss=%dMB lines=%d err=%r" % (dt, rc, rss//1024, len(lines), err[:150]))
for l in lines:
    if l.startswith(b'{"checkpoint"'):
        v = json.loads(l)["checkpoint"]
        print("   checkpoint canonical bytes:", canonical(v), "limit:", 512 + 8192*4096)
PYEOF
